captions: 9:20 a.m. You're looking for your old charger.
Top shelf. Behind the books. Something soft with dust.
First page, in your dad's handwriting: your name.
Last Ramadan you promised Him: every single day.
You sit on the prayer mat. Wipe the cover with your sleeve.
Two minutes. It waited 232 days for two minutes.
